links.targetTitle: Osero pairs capital allocation into Sky's collateral portfol

title: A capped OSM wrapper takes the minimum of the SKY oracle price and a hard cap, so leverage cannot grow with SKY's price
content:
A.4.4.1.3.9 states both the mechanism and the threat model: "In order to prevent excessive price spikes if there is high demand for leverage against SKY tokens, which could potentially lead to excessive USDS borrowing against SKY, a wrapper for the SKY OSM contract has been developed." The wrapper "enforces an upper limit on the price of SKY" for borrowing purposes, taking the minimum of the oracle price and the `cap` parameter — currently 0.025 USDS (A.4.4.1.3.9.2.3).

The loop being broken is reflexive. Higher SKY price means more borrowing power per token, which funds more SKY purchases, which raises the price further. On the way up this manufactures collateral out of its own consequences; on the way down it unwinds violently, and the collateral backing outstanding USDS evaporates exactly when liquidation depth is thinnest. The problem is acute for a governance token, whose price is partly a function of the protocol's own perceived health.

Capping the *price input* is a blunt but robust intervention. It is deliberately **one-sided**: falls in SKY price pass through fully and immediately (the oracle wins the minimum), while rises stop contributing borrowing power above the cap. Borrowers get no credit for speculative appreciation but bear the full weight of declines, so the facility's collateralization can only improve as SKY rallies.

The trade-off is that after sustained genuine appreciation the cap makes SKY-backed borrowing progressively less useful, and the cap becomes a parameter that must be raised by governance — a manual step in a design that otherwise prefers automation. A.4.4.1.3.9.2.2 assigns that to the Core Facilitator in consultation with the Risk Advisor, on the weekly cycle without a prior Governance Poll.
description: Explicitly built "to prevent excessive price spikes if there is high demand for leverage against SKY tokens" — the cap is currently 0.025 USDS, breaking the reflexive price-collateral feedback loop.
